title: Don't automatically connect to VPN on reboot by default
line: Imported WireGuard VPN configurations no longer connect automatically at every boot.
explanation: WireGuard connections created from scratch in the connection editor already get autoconnect turned off, but importing a WireGuard .conf file goes through libnm's nm_conn_wireguard_import(), which leaves NetworkManager's default autoconnect=yes. Since WireGuard is a device-type connection, NetworkManager then brings the tunnel up on every boot, routing traffic through the remote network. The change turns autoconnect off on the imported connection before it is added, in both the Wi-Fi & Networking KCM and its QML port.

commits.message:
kcms: don't autoconnect imported WireGuard connections

WireGuard connections created in the editor already have autoconnect
off, but importing a .conf file through libnm kept NetworkManager's
default, so the tunnel came up on every boot. Turn it off on import too.

BUG: 493497

media.caption: A WireGuard .conf imported in Wi-Fi & Networking: "Connect automatically with priority" is checked
Same import with the fix: "Connect automatically" is unchecked

review.text: Clean and targeted fix that disables connection.autoconnect on WireGuard profiles imported via libnm in both the QWidgets and QML networking KCMs, matching what the connection editor already does for manually created WireGuard connections. Limiting this to WireGuard is accurate since NetworkManager ignores connection.autoconnect for type=vpn plugins, and the before/after screenshots and D-Bus payload check clearly verify the change.
